subject: Vendor activation — invoice delivery options & onboarding workbook
messages:
From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@lumensupply.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: billing_ops@lumensupply.com
Date: 2025-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick questions about invoice submission during activation

Hi Kimberly,

We’re scheduled to go live with Redwood on July 1 and I’m working through the AP handoff. Two quick items I’d like to confirm so our billing team can prepare: 

1) Portal vs email: if we set up the portal integration are we expected to stop sending invoices to billing@redwood.com entirely, or is there an overlapping grace window?
2) Invoice template: we currently send PDF invoices generated from our ERP. Redwood has sample CSV headers — do you require a header-based CSV for portal, or is the portal able to ingest a standard PDF layout (we’ll attach an example)?

I attached a one-page PDF of our current invoice format and I can share our sample CSV if that will help. Also: does Redwood expect PO numbers to appear in the subject line for email fallbacks?

Thanks — appreciate any short guidance I can pass to our AP manager.

Best,
Elena Costa
Vendor Operations Lead
LumenSupply Inc.
attachments: sample-invoice-example.pdf (application/pdf)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@lumensupply.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick questions about invoice submission during activation

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the PDF. Short answers up front:

• Portal preferred; we ask customers to transition fully to the portal within the first 30 days of activation, but we allow a two-week overlapping grace period to avoid missed payments. During the overlap our ingestion team watches both channels and reconciles duplicates.

• Portal ingestion: the portal accepts CSV/JSON structured payloads as the primary method (these give the most reliable PO matching). We also accept PDF invoices as a fallback; our PDF OCR pipeline can extract totals and POs but has a higher error rate and slower acknowledgement. If your ERP can export a simple CSV (one line per line-item) that will reduce reconciliation friction.

• Subject token: for email fallbacks we recommend including the PO number in the subject in this exact pattern: Redwood-PO:<PO_NUMBER>. That lets our router auto-tag and route without manual triage.

I’m looping in Vanessa (on onboarding) and Marcus (AP integration) to share a short onboarding workbook that lists required headers and the graceful-fallback rules. I’ll also attach the workbook link and a copy of the minimal CSV spec.

Action items for LumenSupply:
- Can you export a one-line-per-line-item CSV sample (include PO, invoice_number, invoice_date, line_description, quantity, unit_price, tax, total, vendor_tax_id)?
- If not possible, confirm you’ll use PDF-only and we’ll note a higher manual exception rate.

We’ll aim to have the portal account live and a test ingest before July 1.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: lumen_onboarding_workbook.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Costa <elena.costa@lumensupply.com>
Date: 2025-06-21T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick questions about invoice submission during activation

Kimberly / Marcus — attaching the onboarding workbook I promised (also uploaded to drive). Notes I added to the "Invoice channel" tab:

- Minimal CSV header set (portal): invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, vendor_name, vendor_tax_id, line_id, line_description, quantity, unit_price, line_tax, line_total, invoice_total, currency, remit_to_entity
- PO visibility: portal will auto-link when po_number matches the entity in Redwood. If LumenSupply has multi-entity POs, include remit_to_entity to disambiguate.
- Email fallback conventions: subject must include Redwood-PO:<PO_NUMBER>. If multiple POs on one invoice, separate with commas (Redwood-PO:12345,67890). Attachments accepted: PDF, TIFF; max 10 MB.
- Acknowledgement SLA: portal CSV = ack within 2 minutes; PDF/email = ack within 24 hours (manual triage window).

Marcus — can your team confirm whether we can accept LumenSupply's PDF sample with a simple mapping rule before they produce CSVs? I suspect we can map invoice_number and PO from the sample, but if they have line-level quantities in a table our OCR will likely mis-map the line_id order.

Elena — if you can drop a short CSV sample by end of day Tuesday that would let us run a smoke test. If you prefer, we can also schedule a 20-minute screen share to walk the export.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference
attachments: lumen_onboarding_workbook.xlsx (see Drive link)

From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@lumensupply.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-23T15:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick questions about invoice submission during activation

Thanks Kimberly & Vanessa — really helpful.

I’ve attached a sanitized CSV export from our ERP with two invoice lines (we redacted customer-specific free-text). Let me know if the headers match what you expect. If all looks good we’ll plan to switch to portal-first and continue email as a 14-day overlap.

Also, one small ask: can you confirm the exact subject token (case-sensitive) you prefer? We’ll implement the subject rule in our email templates so there’s no ambiguity.

Elena Costa
Vendor Operations Lead
LumenSupply Inc.
attachments: lumen_sample_export.csv (text/csv)
